title: Fail-closed bounded SAST processing-error localization
goal: Restore actionable, privacy-preserving localization of genuine gosec Go processing errors without suppressing findings or changing the mandatory gate.
invariants: A gosec processing error always blocks SAST; zero bypasses or exception baselines.
No untrusted gosec error body, source snippet, secret, or external absolute path enters CI output.
Only existing normalized in-repository Go file paths, at most four, and reviewed scan module root are displayed.
Go security tool versions, scope and vulnerability/finding policies stay unchanged.
security_properties: Raw compiler/parser error messages and paths outside repo are never leaked.
Errors lacking safe path remain blocking and clearly diagnosed as unresolved.

migration.rationale: Engineering CLI diagnostics only; no product data model change

rollback.strategy: Revert the bounded diagnostic formatting without relaxing any SAST gate
verification: Security static parser tests and adaptive CI remain mandatory

inputs: GitHub exact #154 HEAD fb2988df301d3d6e531d3c85f2f9dc6bbe22557f and engineering-kernel run 39346089085
Existing pinned gosec v2.28.0 processing error fail-closed parser and E4-SEC-002B-ACTIVATE security owner
outputs: Sanitized module and repository-local source-path labels only when gosec reports processing errors
Actual GitHub CI rerun to identify still-failing Go module without leaking diagnostic payload
acceptance_tests: Gosec processing errors continue to fail CHK-SAST-GO even when their paths are unavailable.
Security_static_test ensures only existing normalized repository-local Go files are ever exposed; source content and external paths are absent.
Exact SHA engineering-kernel result recorded; no claim of green gate without successful actual check.
definition_of_ready: Existing security SAST control owner verified
Real processing error seen on exact #154 CI; source diagnostics withheld, so safe localization is necessary
definition_of_done: New code committed and reviewed as engineering security owner change
Tests and exact SHA CI demonstrate whether the processing error is resolved or safely localized
Follow-up to address actual reported Go module processing root rather than disable SAST

performance_budget.rationale: Only at most four bounded SAST error-file path labels at development time
